meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 启用后自动生效：会话开始和用户提交提示时注入静态项目指令，apply_patch 后注入匹配的文件规则；动态输出作为额外上下文注入并去重，不重写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问规则行为、注入的项目规则、规则文件位置等时触发；插件启用后也在会话开始等时机自动注入规则。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: 会列出 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等位置。

say.text: 当前项目注入了哪些规则？
say.note: 会检查并说明注入的静态与文件规则。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, it injects static project instructions at session start and on user prompt submit, injects matching file rules after apply_patch, and adds deduplicated dynamic output as context without rewriting tool output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about rule behavior, injected project rules, rule file locations, etc. Once enabled, it also auto-injects rules at session start.

say_en.text: Which rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
How do I use the CODEX_RULES_MODE environment variable?
What rules are injected in the current project?
say_en.note: Checks and reports injected static and file rules.
